submissions.title: SpaceXAI confirmed behind Cochise County, Arizona supercomputer campus proposal
submissions.excerpt: on the order of $3.6 billion of applicant-funded transmission and substation improvements
submissions.note: NEW PROJECT, not currently tracked (no Arizona projects in the snapshot). SpaceX/xAI, now branded SpaceXAI, has been confirmed as the party behind a proposed nine-building supercomputer/AI data center campus on ~747 acres in Cochise County, AZ, filed through applicant Tombstone Resources. Reported total build-out up to 6 GW across four ~1.5 GW phases, with phase 1 around 1,500 MW -- this is a SITE POWER target at full build-out, not IT load, and is still pre-permitting (Planning & Zoning Commission public hearing scheduled Dec 9, 2026), not yet approved or under construction. A widely circulated $50B total-investment figure is UNVERIFIED -- several outlets (Aterio, KJZZ) flag it as reported but not tied to a specific phase or confirmed by the company -- so it is deliberately left out of the claims below and noted here for context only. The $3.6B claim is grid/transmission infrastructure capex quoted from the county application as covered by trade press; do not conflate with total project capex. Caveat: this run's sandbox could not reach most external sites directly (WebFetch/curl blocked outside a small allowlist), so this excerpt was extracted via a search-engine intermediary rather than a direct fetch of the article -- please verify exact wording against the primary DatacenterDynamics/Baxtel coverage and the Cochise County application before relying on it.

submissions.title: City of Boise approves emergency moratorium on large data centers
submissions.excerpt: facilities over 100,000 square feet or with at least 20 megawatts of projected demand at full buildout
submissions.note: SITING RESTRICTION: Boise, ID city council voted unanimously on Nov 10, 2026 to adopt an emergency six-month moratorium on large data center development, effective immediately. It halts acceptance/processing of new applications for facilities over 100,000 sq ft or with projected demand of at least 20 MW at full buildout; projects with planning approval predating the moratorium are grandfathered. Proposed by Mayor Lauren McLean; the city says there were no pending mega-data-center applications at the time. This is a jurisdiction-wide zoning action, not tied to any single tracked project, so no projectId is attached (per the policy against inferring project links from location). Caveat: WebFetch/curl to external sites was blocked this run, so the excerpt is a close paraphrase surfaced via search rather than a direct fetch of the ordinance text -- please verify against Boise's own council/ordinance records before citing.
